name: Team with security review
description: The standard team plus a security reviewer who can send the code back to Dev to fix risky findings, up to twice. The code reviewer can send it back once when the code misses part of the requirement. Use it for code that handles user input, money or credentials.

steps.name: Security reviewer
steps.purpose: Looks for ways the code could be misused or leak data, and sends it back to Dev if something is risky.
steps.instructions: Review every change for security problems: unvalidated input, injection, unsafe file or network access, secrets in code, numeric overflow or rounding that could lose money, and missing error handling that could leak internal details. Only report real, specific problems with file:line and a suggested fix. Use VERDICT: changes only for findings rated high or critical, or for code that does not do what a requirement clause says.
produces: .devcrew/security.md: a verdict and security findings by severity

steps.name: Reviewer
steps.purpose: Gives a second opinion on the code: design, clarity and security, the things tests cannot see. Sends it back to Dev once if the code misses something the requirement asks for.
produces: .devcrew/review.md: a verdict and findings by severity
